test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in two parallel rows such that three of them in one row facing north and the other three are sitting in the second row facing south. P is facing south. U sits opposite to R. R faces the same direction as P. S does not face south. T faces north but is not sitting opposite P. Who sits opposite to T?
solution:
Given: Six people P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in two parallel rows such that three of them in one row facing north and the other three are sitting in the second row facing south.

1) P is facing south.

2) U sits opposite to R.

3) R faces the same direction as P.

4) T faces north but is not sitting opposite P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/723b05ba860986932f7de9a6b83499a8e35ad6fc80394e977941ad7ffa5cbcb2.png] 

5) S does not face south.

And, Q will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e63b97461bdb919cc8630881644d14cd887568a9a1eeef539878a50d83c1b9b4.png] 

So, Q sits opposite to T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
